answer: Replaying a stored transcript fails because the challenge words differ every epoch, and fabricating a commitment fails a hollow spot-check that re-runs the prompt. Producing 98 answers an epoch therefore burns 95 real forward passes, and the bridge record lets any auditor recompute the check. Each answer is accompanied by a commitment to the inference that produced it: a model fingerprint plus a hash of the token logits, posted as an oasis header. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
